comparison.objective: Transfer a height with a water level and mark it without spilling; candidate calibrates proximity switches.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual liquid-level referencing, remote marking, and spill avoidance versus confined screwdriver use and mounted-part adjustment.
comparison.success_condition: Mark within 1.5 mm, ≤1 mL spill, hose safe, equipment returned; candidate requires two ≤6 mm over-center sensor registrations.
comparison.reason: Both use feedback-based registration, but the physical mechanism and tested manipulation ability are materially different. Candidate indicator hysteresis remains unspecified.
